results.text: Renalase protects against podocyte injury by inhibiting oxidative stress and apoptosis in diabetic nephropathy. Diabetic nephropathy (DN) presents a significant public health challenge due to its high rate of incidence and severe health consequences. Renalase has been identified as having renal-protective properties. A key contributor to albuminuria in DN patients is podocyte loss.
